items.title: 'They are getting fooled': How ultra-processed food is made to look healthier
items.description: Industry insiders reveal how Australians are being deceived by marketing and labelling that makes ultra-processed foods appear healthier than they really are.

items.title: National records tumble as Australia's athletics team stuns in Glasgow
items.description: Lachlan Kennedy and Torrie Lewis set new national records in claiming 100m medals, Eleanor Patterson won high jump gold, and Australia's swimmers were spectacular again.

items.title: 'The Aussies are on fire' on a night where that should've been impossible
items.description: Australian athletics lives up to the immense hype on a night of glorious culmination for Lachie Kennedy, Torrie Lewis and their team.

items.title: Live: Taylor insists he did not make payment to faction at centre of ICAC probe
items.description: Angus Taylor has insisted he did not make a payment to a NSW Liberal Party faction at the centre of a corruption watchdog probe. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Victorian premier spruiks worker protection scheme day after taking job
items.description: Ben Carroll starts his first full day as Victorian premier, after replacing Jacinta Allan as the new leader of the Victorian Labor Party.

items.title: Live: Video of Japan earthquake mall explosion emerges as deaths confirmed
items.description: Authorities are scouring the wreckage of a collapsed shopping centre southern Japan following a magnitude-7.1 earthquake. Follow live.

items.title: Home loan borrowers missing out on millions in offset savings
items.description: The corporate regulator found Australian banks paid more than $55 million in compensation in just two years, for failures with mortgage offset accounts, warning customers could be paying more interest than they should.

items.title: 'Australia's Banksy' rape case witness wants the courts to hear this
items.description: A woman who accused street artist Anthony Lister of rape is speaking up to help others navigate the police and court systems. Lister was acquitted of all charges last year.

items.title: Angus Taylor likes to talk about systems. People are his 'kryptonite'
items.description: In an interview for Kitchen Cabinet, the opposition leader recalls feeling a sense of overwhelm and reverence for the parliament when first he took his seat there.

items.title: Community in 'shock' amid search for missing boy resuming off SA coast
items.description: The search for a missing three-month-old in SA's South East will resume today, as police continue to investigate the circumstances surrounding the deaths of the boy's mother and sister. The tragedies have shocked the state and left locals stunned.

items.title: PM's data centre plan may hit roadblock as energy debate heats up
items.description: As two energy ministers oppose the prime minister's plan for national AI rules for data centres, the question over how to power the facilities intensifies.

items.title: Fresh DNA evidence in 'Echo Point Man' cold case
items.description: Police hope fresh DNA evidence will help them crack a more than two-decades-old cold case in the NSW Blue Mountains.

items.title: Trump vents about Netanyahu on TV ahead of meeting
items.description: In the latest sign of shaky relations between the war-entangled leaders, Donald Trump uses a TV interview to publicly express his frustration with Benjamin Netanyahu's apparent efforts to pressure him to keep attacking Iran.

items.title: Live: ASX tipped to rise ahead of key inflation numbers
items.description: The big focus locally is the consumer price index and what it will mean for interest rates. Globally, chipmaker stocks have been dumped, but the Dow rose on Wall Street. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: All the snubs and surprises from this year's Miles Franklin shortlist
items.description: ABC experts unpack the shortlist of Australia's biggest book prize: who made it, who missed out and who they think will win.

items.title: Australians are the villains in star-studded New Zealand spy comedy
items.description: What happens when you take the exciting world of spies and subterfuge to 1970s New Zealand? We talk to Paul Williams and Bret McKenzie about making their childhood fantasies come true in hilarious new comedy.

items.title: Quiz: 10 travel questions, now boarding at Gate 5
items.description: Which NSW town was the movie Babe filmed in? And where would you find the Atlas Mountains?

items.title: New Pacific aid map shows 'striking' shift away from China
items.description: Australia supplants China as the dominant lender and infrastructure investor across the Pacific as the government ploughs billions of dollars into the region through both foreign aid and loans.

items.title: The graph that doesn't match the narrative on productivity
items.description: The "non-market sector" is not the same thing as "the public sector" or "the government", it's worth knowing the difference.

items.title: Experts cautious about endometriosis saliva test being trialled overseas
items.description: Manufacturers of a non-invasive saliva test say it can accurately diagnose endometriosis, but Australian experts warn there isn't enough reliable research to show the test works in the real world.

items.title: Hundreds of Queensland social housing tenants evicted after review
items.description: Dozens of households have been kicked out of social housing in Queensland after being found to own property or earn more than $80,000 a year.

items.title: Warning social media giants might wear fines to help sink the age ban
items.description: In a damning submission, an age-check firm warns big fines may be seen as a "small price to pay" if copping them allows Australia's ban to be "wrongly" be portrayed as a failure.

items.title: Billion-dollar industry 'watching, not panicking' over bird flu spread
items.description: Queensland's poultry industry is on high alert after the state's first H5 bird flu detection, but consumers are being told there is no need to panic.

items.title: Underbelly of Victoria's Big Build to be exposed by royal commission
items.description: After toppling his boss yesterday, new Victorian Premier Ben Carroll used his first press conference to tell voters who he is not.

items.title: Lindsay Graham 'never saw a war he didn't like', Trump jokes at funeral
items.description: Donald Trump has praised Lindsey Graham at his Washington funeral, which included high-profile guests Benjamin Netanyahu and Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
